title: Background tasks and concurrency helpers
summary:
Background task support and synchronous/asynchronous execution utilities.

Agent mapper reason: These modules support work scheduled around request completion and sync/async execution; the inventory has no dedicated background-task test file, so application and dependency lifecycle tests provide adjacent coverage.

ownedFiles.reason: Provides background task abstractions for response handling.
Provides concurrency helpers used by framework execution paths.

contextFiles.reason: Routes and responses attach background tasks to request handling.
Response objects can carry background tasks.
Dependency cleanup and execution may use concurrency helpers.
